lines.text: In the evening, a rich disciple named Joseph from Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus.
Joseph wrapped the body in a clean linen cloth and placed it in his own new tomb.
Joseph rolled a great log across the entrance, and Mary Magdalene and the other Mary sat opposite the tomb.
The chief priests and Pharisees asked Pilate to secure the tomb until the seventh day.
Pilate told them to secure the tomb, so they sealed the stone and posted the guard.
